neighbours.label: a verb of putting components together in a recipe or preparation (assemble, mix, fill, build, wrap up, top)
fire: Once the sauce has cooled, layer the noodles and cheese to assemble the lasagna.
Spoon the berries into the jars and fill each one with warm syrup.
Spread the beans on the tortilla, add salsa, and roll it up tightly.
Each bowl is built from rice, grilled tofu and pickled carrots.
Stir the powder into cold milk to mix a quick breakfast shake.
Pile the pancakes high and top them with butter and maple syrup.
Stack the bread, ham and cheese to put the sandwich together.
For the salad, combine the lettuce, olives and feta in a large bowl.
quiet: Once the sauce has cooled, bake the lasagna for forty minutes.
Wash the berries under cold water and let them dry on a towel.
Warm the tortilla in a dry pan for about thirty seconds.
The rice should simmer for fifteen minutes with the lid on.
Heat the milk gently in a small pot until it steams.
Cook the pancakes until small bubbles appear on the surface.
Slice the bread thinly with a sharp serrated knife.
Chill the lettuce in the fridge for an hour before serving.

notes: Top examples: 'To assemble:', 'drink mix', 'can be built using', 'fill the rest of the cup', 'wrap it up', 'topped'. The + pole is mounting/laminating onto a backing (slides, frames, menus). Near misses: same recipes with heating, cutting or waiting verbs.
